sharedPrompt: Use case: lighting-weather. Asset type: January seasonal header illustration for Tristana, one single landscape image, 1536 by 1024, 3:2 aspect ratio. Input image is the edit target and style reference. Create a distinctly different winter variation described below while preserving the refined detailed watercolor/gouache illustration style, natural believable forms, paper texture, cream fade and overall app composition. Scene lives on the right 60-70 percent; far left 30 percent remains nearly blank pale warm ivory #fef9ef, with a curved irregular watercolor fade sweeping inward from left and the bottom 15-20 percent softly dissolving to the SAME ivory. Do not add dark full-frame background even for night. Keep winter season, heavy snow, no people, text, labels, borders, collage, buildings other than described, cars, seasonal decorations, or summer plants. This is an actual image asset, not an app screenshot. Lighting variation should be substantial and beautiful, not a simple color filter. PRIMARY REQUEST:

variants.title: Snowy cottage · pink dawn
variants.request: The snow-covered timber-and-stone cottage and surrounding conifer forest just before sunrise: faint coral-pink clouds above, cool lavender-blue snow, only first soft rosy light on highest snowy branches. Warm window glow still visible, fine chimney smoke. The sun is not yet above the horizon.

variants.title: Snowy forest · silver fog
variants.request: A forest of tall snow-laden firs and cedars in thick silver winter morning fog. Layered trunks recede into mist; diffused pearly light, no visible sun. Heavy rounded untouched snowdrifts. Make the atmospheric lighting substantially different from the original golden sun.

variants.title: Ridgefield swans · misty dawn
variants.request: Ridgefield wetland and snowy auto-tour road at earliest dawn: a thin pink strip on the horizon, lavender predawn sky, dark open unfrozen wetland with low delicate mist and graceful winter swans swimming quietly. Snowy bare trees and reeds, cool lavender snow. Preserve believable open water; no frozen pond.

variants.title: Hearth · blue predawn
variants.request: The plaster arched hearth, ceramic vase of dried winter seed stems, stacked logs and narrow window before dawn. Outside is a snowy evergreen forest in subdued cobalt and violet, the first pale rose strip on the horizon, no moon. Low glowing embers and a small fire warm the room; indoor shadows long and quiet. Retain the cozy interior subject and winter outside, pale left and lower margins.

variants.title: Snowy forest · moonlight
variants.request: Snow-covered winter conifer forest on a clear moonlit night. A modest full moon high at upper right casts cold silvery highlights and long blue shadows on smooth snowdrifts; snowy firs fade into deep navy distance. Sparse realistic stars, no daylight or sunset glow. Keep the image's far left and bottom pale warm ivory for the app despite the dark painted scene on the right.

variants.title: Ridgefield swans · golden sunset
variants.request: Snow-covered Ridgefield wetland auto-tour route at sunset. Winter swans glide on unfrozen water reflecting gold and copper from low sunset clouds, snowy reeds and bare cottonwoods have amber edges and soft violet shadows. A different arrangement of swimming swans, wide curving road and wetland. Still visibly deep winter, no green meadow or warm-season flowers.

variants.title: Snowy Rainier forest · alpenglow
variants.request: A variation in a deeply snow-covered Mount Rainier conifer forest just after sunrise, with a distant recognizable snowy volcanic summit visible between tall firs in the upper-right distance. Pink alpenglow on the peak and tree tips; blue-violet shadows in untouched snowdrifts. Peach and pale yellow winter sky, no bare summer ground.

variants.title: Snowy stream · winter sunbeams
variants.request: A winter stream in a snow-laden old-growth cedar and fir forest, low late-morning sunshine breaking through mist into visible diagonal shafts across the right-hand scene. Dark clear flowing water reflecting small golden patches, thick smooth snow on rocks and banks, sparkling frost on evergreen needles. New arrangement of tall trunks and cascading stream, unmistakably January winter.

variants.title: Million Dollar Highway · blue hour
variants.request: Snow-covered San Juan Mountains and winding Million Dollar Highway in predawn blue hour. variants.title: Hearth · winter sunset

Small glowing fire and soft room light, no moon, no painted decorative sun circle.

variants.title: Snowy forest · falling snow
variants.request: A dense snow-covered conifer forest during active snowfall at midday. Soft overcast gray-blue light, visible fine flakes against deep fir branches, no visible sun or sunbeams. Closely spaced trees under heavy soft white snow, smoothly drifted forest floor; a sheltered intimate woodland composition differing from the open original. Preserve creamy app-safe left and bottom.

variants.title: San Juan road · clearing storm
variants.request: A packed-snow mountain road in Colorado's San Juan range as a winter storm clears. Rugged snow-covered mountains partially veiled by fast low storm clouds, one dramatic opening of pale yellow sunlight illuminates a far snowy ridge, foreground road and snowy pines remain cool shadow. Dense snow over all exposed ground. No vehicles, no bare asphalt.

Pale mauve and peach clouds, cold blue snow shadows. Believable small cabin, no decorations, no people, no tracks.

variants.title: Cascade mountain pass · winter sun
variants.request: A winding packed-snow mountain road through a Washington Cascade mountain pass, new location variation on the snowy mountain highway idea. Dense snow-laden tall firs, broad rugged snowy peaks in upper-right distance, bright clear winter midday sky and white high clouds. Deep untouched snowy banks, crisp cool sunlight and blue shadows, no cars, no bare pavement, no summer vegetation.
